subject: general
question: In which year was the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana' launched by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__2020.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojna (ABRY) was launched on **1st October 2020**.
 
• ABRY was launched by **The Ministry of Labour and Employment** of India.
 
• It was Primarily for the workers especially those working in **MSMEs(Micro Small and Medium Enterprises).**
 
• The Government allocated a sum of **Rs 22,810 crore.**
